name: Major cyber incidents
summary: Ransomware at Guadeloupe's university hospital from 21 Nov has postponed planned care to 27 Nov; staff on paper
state: Guadeloupe's university hospital was hit by an external cyberattack on the evening of 21 Nov, apparently ransomware that encrypted some databases, and activated its emergency plan on 22 Nov; surgery, imaging and non-urgent consultations are postponed until 27 Nov and staff are working without computers or phones (Next). ANSSI is assisting and entry is thought to have come through a previously compromised IT supplier (Next; Ouest-France). Separately, the West Virginia Legislature's IT systems were disabled by a cyber incident from 19 Nov (The Record). Disruption to a hospital keeps Watch; no national-scale attack was found.
for_you: Organisations can follow NCSC guidance on ransomware and supplier security. Patients in Guadeloupe should follow instructions from the hospital and regional health agency.
rubric_hit: Ransomware disrupting a critical service: Guadeloupe university hospital on emergency plan since 22 Nov
